revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: A completed CPU DirectDraw pixel copy publishes its exact window, selected layer/canvas, memory, instance and D3DIM endpoint/epoch for native input observation. This does not fabricate a GPU Presenter frame. The record is replaced only by a later real copy and cleared on D3DIM close; guard identity fences reject endpoint/epoch, source, window, memory and layer changes. No guest calls, callback registrations, continuation, scheduling or native receipt changes. Actual host-copy pixels and old-failing/new-passing native USER owner regression plus lifetime rejection controls are retained in run 20261121-zuma-d3dim-owner. General callback ownership remains pending.
